precision: Round changed tensor to original BF16 before free generation
value_formula: Project g*E[target] orthogonally to the union of top competitor g*E rows. Scale that direction to close the maximum native raw-logit gap plus four mean-RMS logit units. This preserves competing raw logits rather than just reducing one wrong token.
weight_formula: K=mean native relation keys; Q=principal subspace of controls AND earlier non-decision prefix states; Z=K-KQQt; deltaW=Vt pinv(Z)t.
rationale: Measured old creator value made Ge rank 4 while G ranked 1. Orthogonal readout correction made Ge rank 1 in the five-point diagnostic. Earlier prefix states are now explicitly protected against linear spillover.
